request.description: Run first. Creates PM-SEC-CUSTOMER-001 with KES 5,000.
Run after Register customer. Creates the merchant used by the payment requests.

item.name: Pay merchant - KES 200 plus KES 30 fee

exec: pm.test("Payment amounts", () => { pm.expect(body.amount).to.eql(200); pm.expect(body.fee).to.eql(30); pm.expect(body.totalDebit).to.eql(230); pm.expect(body.availableBalance).to.eql(4770); pm.expect(body.currency).to.eql("KES"); });

request.description: First payment returns 201. Repeat the replay request to verify the same key does not debit again.

item.name: Replay original payment without another debit
Reject same key with different amount

exec: pm.test("Payment details and order", () => { body.transactions.forEach((item, index) => { pm.expect(item.reference).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(item.merchantAccountNumber).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(item.fee).to.eql(30); pm.expect(item.totalDebit).to.be.closeTo(item.amount + item.fee, 0.001); pm.expect(item.balanceAfter).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(Number.isNaN(Date.parse(item.paidAt))).to.eql(false); if (index > 0) pm.expect(Date.parse(body.transactions[index - 1].paidAt)).to.be.at.least(Date.parse(item.paidAt)); }); });
